sections.description: Theme-independent WPForms recipe link delivery with optional newsletter provider add-ons.
sections.changelog:
= 2.6.2 =
* Receive the licensing connection through the existing GitHub updater. Connect once under Settings → MTT updates for future official updates; installed features keep working.
* Show a clear connection status, shorter setup help and update access for installed plugins only.

= 2.6.1 =
* Use the shared MTT admin UI library for consistent controls, layouts and keyboard focus.

* Report protected update outcomes through the shared website connection without sending content or credentials.

= 2.6.0 =
* Share one website key across MTT plugins with encrypted storage and manual site approval.
* Protect official update delivery while keeping installed features working.

= 2.1.2 =
* Fade popups and their backdrops in gently, respecting reduced-motion preferences.

= 2.1.1 =
* Choose newsletter providers from a compact logo list with Connect buttons and setup shown on demand.
* Keep editor drafts while activating an installed provider add-on, with clearer saved and pending states.

= 2.1.0 =
* Make popup button and subscription copy editable beside the heading and introduction.
* Preserve saved forms, submitted checkbox values and initial selection when overriding popup text.

= 2.0.0 =
* Move newsletter providers into optional shared Kit, Flodesk and Attentive add-ons.
* Show the selected provider and inactive add-on status while preserving saved account settings.
* Require the matching add-on for newsletter signup; saved email delivery continues independently.

= 1.6.0 =
* Add editable popup heading and introduction, with a direct link to the connected WPForms form.
* Add close-button hooks so themes can reuse their own accessible icon styling.

= 1.5.0 =
* Add reusable Save to Email popup buttons through a native core Button preset and shortcode.
* Reuse the configured WPForms delivery and consent workflow with accessible dialog controls.

= 1.4.3 =
* Add shared audience events with deduplication, retention and WordPress privacy export/erasure.

= 1.4.2 =
* Format Flodesk consent timestamps with UTC Z and milliseconds to prevent rejected subscriptions in both WPForms and standalone signup.

= 1.4.1 =
* Send fresh opt-in timestamp and available request IP with consenting Save Recipe submissions through WPForms Flodesk connections so returning subscribers can resubscribe.
* Keep consent metadata scoped to the matching subscriber request; preserve unchecked consent, failed delivery, and connection conditions.

= 1.4.0 =
* Show WPForms-owned Flodesk accounts and segment names directly in Integrations.
* Let the form handle its Flodesk signup once, respecting consent and connection conditions, while Save to Email sends the recipe.
* Explain Save Recipe form setup and retain standalone integration settings for installations without form connections.

= 1.3.3 =
* Load Flodesk segments after saving credentials and show a dropdown only when choices are available. Preserve the saved segment while controls are hidden.

= 1.3.2 =
* Point shared branding links and help text to Settings > Reply Notifications.

= 1.3.1 =
* Display the official Made to Thrive circle badge in WordPress plugin updates.

= 1.3.0 =
* Add optional Kit and Flodesk integrations, provider selection, safe connection checks and preserved Flodesk upgrade settings.

= 1.2.4 =
* Use the plugin name without an MTT prefix; retain Made to Thrive authorship and the handwritten mtt icon.

= 1.2.3 =
* Replace the pixel field with Small, Medium and Large logo presets; default to Medium.

= 1.2.2 =
* Edit footer text inline in the email preview.

= 1.2.1 =
* Link the logo, hide duplicate site text, and place the heading before the greeting.

= 1.2.0 =
* Use native media and color pickers with a responsive branding sidebar and live preview.
* Hide shared branding controls unless the provider is available.

= 1.1.0 =
* Add standalone branding and sender controls with optional shared branding.

= 1.0.1 =
* Show an actionable form error when email delivery fails or is rate limited.
* Prevent success redirects and newsletter requests after failed delivery.
* Require the newsletter consent mapping to point to a checkbox field.

= 1.0.0 =
* Extract reusable recipe delivery from the Bake With Zoha implementation.
* Add MTT update-channel support and independent settings.
* Keep other newsletter forms under their existing provider settings.
* Reject password-protected posts and invalid recipe requests before subscription.

= 1.4.4 =
* Add the shared MTT brand mark to the settings heading with local assets and reserved dimensions.
